notes.title: Bug Fixes and Tweaks:
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed collision from the Ghost NPC (because its a ghost...) and added a spookey glow.
[*] Added interact popup when within interact range of an object.
[*] Fixed issue when starting a new game and not having full stats.
[*] Changed enemy behavior to aggro when attacked at long range.
[*] Fixed Show Tutorial toggle in the settings menu.
[/list]
